content.text: MOA: anti-inflam via multi actions on WBCs
Carpal tunnel syndrome: local inj (or PO)
Plantar fasciitis: inj ⍉1st-line (↑risk of fascia rupture + fat pad atrophy) → short-term only - topical: limited evidence
▪︎OA: intra-articular inj relieves joint pain for several wks - ≤4x/yr per joint
Pericarditis: refractory/recurr only - ⍉routine early (↑recurr) - ⍉after MI (impairs myocard heal)
▪︎Alopecia areata: intralesional corticosteroid (triamcinolone q4–6 wks) - topical corticosteroid (fluocinolone acetonide cream BID)
▪︎Pityriasis rosea: may improve lesions + pruritus but ⍉routine (lack of evidence - relapse concern)
Nasal polyps + allergic rhinitis: short course
Lichen planus: topical or PO steroids (severity-dep)
Aphthous stomatitis: complex/refractory (PO prednisone x4-7 days)
▪︎Bact meningitis: dexamethasone w abx (adjunct) → ↓inflam + prevent neuro comps (ex hearing loss)
▪︎PCP (HIV⊕) mod-severe: add prednisone - PaO2 <70 ≈ SpO2 <~93% or A-a ≥35
▪︎AECOPD: systemic x5d - PO preferred unless can't tolerate (IV ⍉superior)
▪︎Sarcoidosis: tx of choice (prednisone, up to 6mo b4 taper)
▪︎Berylliosis: Sxtomatic + abnl PFTs (ex, prednisone) - most need lifelong ↓dose
▪︎Primary AI (Addison): lifelong replace (prednisone · hydrocortisone · dexamethasone) + mineralocorticoid (fludrocortisone)
▪︎Cushing dz postop: empiric hydrocortisone for cortisol w.draw Sx - taper slowly
▪︎ITP: life-threatening bleed → IV methylprednisolone - ⍉rapid plt rise needed → PO dexamethasone or prednisone
▪︎GPA: systemic GC + MTX (limited dz) - + cyclophosphamide (more severe dz)

GCA: ↑dose prednisone PO (IV methylprednisolone if vision loss)
SLE: short-term prednisone initially → taper once HCQ or chloroquine takes effect

content.text: -    MOA: H1-receptor antagonist (1st-gen, cross BBB) → block CNS his wakefulness → sedation (+ anticholinergic)
-    Clin Use: erythema multiforme - skin discomfort/pruritus (supportive)
-    Acute bronchitis: OTC sx relief option (w expectorants · mucolytics)
-    1st-gen: also brompheniramine · chlorpheniramine · clemastine (cross BBB → sedation + antimuscarinic)

-    2nd-gen: cetirizine · loratadine · fexofenadine · desloratadine · levocetirizine (⍉cross BBB → less sedation + ⍉antimuscarinic) - use: allergic rhinitis · conjunctivitis · urticaria · atopy · eczema · food + drug allergy · hay fever
-    Clin Use: allergy sx (runny nose · sneezing · itchy/watery eyes · throat itching) · common cold sx (adults only) · insomnia (OTC sedative - may help initiate sleep - tolerance develops)

-    Caution: marked drowsiness (↑ w EToH/sedatives/tranquilizers) · ask doctor first: breathing problems · glaucoma · trouble urinating (enlrg prostate) · ⍉ use to make a child sleepy · excitability (children)
-    Toxicity: antimuscarinic + H1 block + Na-channel block → anticholinergic syndrome · sedation · sz/dysrhythmia
-    MOA: phenothiazine H1 antagonist (+ D2 block → antiemetic) → sedation + anticholinergic
-    Clin Use: allergic conditions · motion sickness · N/V · sedation (relieves apprehension → quiet sleep)
-    Caution: ↓ sz threshold · CI comatose states · phenothiazine hypersensitivity/idiosyncratic rxn
-    BBW: potentially fatal resp depression · CI <2 y (peds ≥2 y: use w caution)
